dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) - Listed Buildings polygons, ArcGIS Hub static download
evidence_slice: Historic England publishes National Heritage List for England Listed Buildings as polygons through the Open Data Hub under the Open Government Licence. The official NHLE List Entry 1169607 identifies North Warehouse, Canal Basin, Exeter, with explicit warehouse identity and Exeter Maritime Museum use. A materially different ArcGIS Hub static-download request was made for layer 3 filtered to ListEntry 1169607; the retrieval channel rejected the Hub API URL before any GeoJSON feature payload could be read, so no polygon coordinates were available for acceptance.

field_evidence.footprint: Historic England publishes Listed Buildings as polygons, but the distinct Hub static-download request filtered to ListEntry 1169607 was unreadable before any polygon coordinates were returned; no coordinates were fabricated.
field_evidence.type_use: Official NHLE List Entry 1169607 identifies North Warehouse and records its Exeter Maritime Museum use.
field_evidence.heritage: Official NHLE List Entry 1169607 is a listed building in Exeter.
